sea-ddd-language-values.rationale: Rewritten by the verifier: interchangeable £10 = value object; the person a passport office tracks = entity whose attributes (photo, name) change; limit: a note has a serial number in another model, and in code identity is only an id field, so duplicates must be prevented. Mapping consistent with Evans's Entities/Value Objects.

sea-ddd-aggregate-invariants.rationale: Wiki edit conflict maps the loaded version, the version-checked UPDATE and 0 rows updated; limit: MediaWiki sometimes reconciles automatically (Help:Edit_conflict) while an UPDATE merges nothing. Kept.

sea-ddd-events-contexts.rationale: Admissions desk copying varied referral letters onto one form = anti-corruption layer; limit: explicit rules for unmappable codes and upstream change. Kept; consistent with Evans's ACL pattern.

sea-ddd-investment-pitfalls.rationale: Roasting/ordering spreadsheet/bought payroll = core/supporting/generic; limit: the line is unclear and moves, and one firm's generic is another's core (Evans). Kept.

sea-module-information-hiding.rationale: Pedals hide the engine type, the decision most likely to change (Parnas's criterion); limit: drivers notice some behaviour, like callers relying on unpromised behaviour. Kept.

sea-module-dependency-stability.rationale: Foundations (many dependents) vs light fittings (none) = stable vs unstable in Martin's sense; arrows from fittings to foundations = SDP; limit: a stable package is easy to edit, the cost is in dependents, and abstractions add flexibility. Kept.

sea-module-abstractness-metrics.rationale: Metric interpretation that follows the foundations analogy in the previous unit; another comparison would repeat it.

sea-module-import-cycles.rationale: A procedural import trace plus tool configuration; the step-by-step trace is clearer than a comparison.

sea-module-monolith-dependencies.rationale: Building/flats/front doors/kitchens = deployable/modules/public APIs/internals; limit: only CI checks (Packwerk, Import Linter) enforce the walls, and shared schemas complicate extraction. Kept.

sea-api-signatures.rationale: Short code-centred lesson; the boolean-trap call shows the problem directly.

sea-api-defaults-errors.rationale: Lobby notebook placed on opening day = default list created when def runs; guests without their own = calls omitting tags; limit: no visible warning, and immutable defaults are safe. Consistent with the Python tutorial's 'evaluated only once'. Kept.

sea-api-compatibility-versioning.rationale: SE 01 already teaches Hyrum's law with an analogy; the Go and dict examples are concrete.

sea-api-deprecation-types.rationale: SE 04's street-renaming analogy already teaches add/accept-both/remove; code is the objective.

sea-adr-records.rationale: The unexplained-event-bus opening and full example ADR already make the purpose concrete.

sea-adr-reversibility-fitness.rationale: The lesson's framing is already Bezos's one-way/two-way door metaphor; another would stack metaphors.

sea-adr-incremental-replacement.rationale: Renovating room by room with a camping stove as temporary seam = incremental replacement behind a facade/abstraction; limit: capabilities share data, so data migrations are harder to undo. Kept.

sea-adr-evolution-teams-toggles.rationale: Three loosely related ideas, each tied to a real example (eBay, Conway's paper, Fowler's essay).
